say:0:1010121301:0.text: Look, isn't that <style="highlight">Rowan of the Mithril Consortium</style> at the bridge?

say:1:1010121302:0.text: Didn't expect him to be here. Seems like General Hogan is done with his inquiry.
say:1:1010121302:0.source_cn: 没想到他也和我们同路，看来霍根将军已经询问完了。

say:2:1010121401:1.text: What a coincidence, Master Rowan! Fancy meeting you here.
say:2:1010121401:1.source_cn: 真巧啊，罗万少爷，居然在这里碰见你。

say:3:1010121402:1.text: I saw you in Northville... the guy from the Heroic Order and the mage...
say:3:1010121402:1.source_cn: 你们是……之前在北村的人？耀光骑士团的人，还有魔法师……
say:3:1010121402:1.male: I saw you in Northville... the guy from the Heroic Order and the mage...
say:3:1010121402:1.female: I saw you in Northville... the guy from the Heroic Order and the mage...

choice_prompt:4:1010121402.male: I saw you in Northville... the guy from the Heroic Order and the mage...
choice_prompt:4:1010121402.female: I saw you in Northville... the guy from the Heroic Order and the mage...

say:5:1010121403:1.text: A pleasure to meet you! I'm Rowan of the Mithril Consortium! We didn't get a chance for introductions earlier.
say:5:1010121403:1.source_cn: 幸会，我是秘银商会的罗万！之前情况紧急，都没来得及好好...

say:6:1010121404:1.text: Thanks for helping with the wind elemental. Otherwise, it wouldn't just be my goods that were lost, but my life...
say:6:1010121404:1.source_cn: 感谢你们在北村帮忙解决了风元素，否则不光货物被毁，连我...

choice_prompt:7:1010121404.text: Thanks for helping with the wind elemental. Otherwise, it wouldn't just be my goods that were lost, but my life...
choice_prompt:7:1010121404.source_cn: 感谢你们在北村帮忙解决了风元素，否则不光货物被毁，连我也有生命危险……

say:8:1010121405:1.text: Northville's rich in <style="highlight">wheat</style>. That's where Ryeham got its name.

say:9:1010121406:1.text: I went out of my way to Northville to buy three carts of the best wheat, but it all got burnt by the Scarlet Sorceress.
say:9:1010121406:1.source_cn: 我特意绕道北村收购上好的麦子，整整三车，结果被可恶的灰...

say:10:1010121407:1.text: My whole business venture has been upended, and now this bridge is causing me trouble... I'm trying to figure out what to do next.
say:10:1010121407:1.source_cn: 原本的商业计划都要推翻重做，还得去重新进行备货调查，结...

choice_prompt:11:1010121407.text: My whole business venture has been upended, and now this bridge is causing me trouble... I'm trying to figure out what to do next.
choice_prompt:11:1010121407.source_cn: 原本的商业计划都要推翻重做，还得去重新进行备货调查，结果这座桥还无法通行……我正在想办法。

say:12:1010121408:1.text: I heard that <style="highlight">Southville's Gemvine grapes</style> are worth their weight in gold, so I wanted to check them out. But the <style="highlight">bridge is up</style>, and no one can get across.

say:13:1010121409:1.text: ...It looks like someone <style="highlight">deliberately sabotaged the mechanism</style>. The lever's broken.

say:14:1010121410:1.text: Could be bandits who did this or could be someone else...?
say:14:1010121410:1.source_cn: 不知道是盗匪干的，还是其他别有用心的人……

say:15:1010121411:1.text: Anyway, how much do you know about machinery, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:15:1010121411:1.male: Anyway, how much do you know about machinery, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:15:1010121411:1.female: Anyway, how much do you know about machinery, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:16:1010121411.male: Anyway, how much do you know about machinery, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:16:1010121411.female: Anyway, how much do you know about machinery, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:17:1010121412:1.text: Seems like the all-knowing magister has finally met his match...
say:17:1010121412:1.source_cn: 看起来就算是无所不知的魔法师，也有不了解的知识啊……
say:17:1010121412:1.male: Seems like the all-knowing magister has finally met his match...
say:17:1010121412:1.female: Seems like the all-knowing magister has finally met her match...

say:18:1010121413:1.text: I know a little. The Mithril Consortium handles loads of machinery orders, but we don't currently have any spare parts.
say:18:1010121413:1.source_cn: 我倒是略懂一些，秘银商会经手过不少机械订单，不过现在没...

say:19:1010121414:1.text: To replace the broken lever, we need a <style="highlight">wooden stick of a specific hardness and durability</style>. Aside from that, a lubricant will be needed also for the thing to work.

say:21:1010121415:1.text: Oh... In an emergency, I know that the juice of glowfly fruit can be used as a lubricant.
say:21:1010121415:1.source_cn: 唔……要救急的话，我知道足够成熟的萤瓤果，榨取汁液可以...

say:24:1010121416:1.text: Alright! Gruglins often hoard <style="highlight">glowfly fruit</style> near their camp! Glowfly fruit has that sweet and sour flavor! So good when you can find it!
say:24:1010121416:1.source_cn: 我知道！咕布林经常在营地附近囤积<style=high...

say:25:1010121417:1.text: Gruglins... Yes! The long sticks they carry could be used as a lever.
say:25:1010121417:1.source_cn: 咕布林……它们持拿的武器——那些长棍，或许可以先充当扳手。

say:26:1010121418:0.text: We'd be killing two birds with one stone.
say:26:1010121418:0.source_cn: 很好，一次出击，一举两得。

choice_prompt:27:1010121418.text: We'd be killing two birds with one stone.
choice_prompt:27:1010121418.source_cn: 很好，一次出击，一举两得。

say:28:1010121419:1.text: There's nothing to negotiate. I need to cross the bridge too, and there's no way I can deal with those gruglins by myself.
say:28:1010121419:1.source_cn: 不，谈不上交易，过桥同样是我的需求，而我一个人对付不了...

say:29:1010121420:1.text: So let's work together to collect the materials, then I'll repair the mechanism, and everyone's happy. What do you think?
say:29:1010121420:1.source_cn: 所以我们合作吧。一起收集材料，然后我来维修机关，互惠互...

choice_prompt:30:1010121420.text: So let's work together to collect the materials, then I'll repair the mechanism, and everyone's happy. What do you think?
choice_prompt:30:1010121420.source_cn: 所以我们合作吧。一起收集材料，然后我来维修机关，互惠互利，这样如何？

say:31:1010121421:1.text: There's no time to waste! Quick! Let's go find a <style="highlight">gruglin's club</style> and some <style="highlight">ripe glowfly fruit</style>!
say:31:1010121421:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，快点出发吧——去找<style=highli...

choice:16:1:2.text: Does anyone know anything about this?
choice:16:1:2.male: Does anyone know anything about this?
choice:16:1:2.female: Does anyone know anything about this?

choice:11:1:2.male: Where are you trying to go?
choice:11:1:2.female: Where are you trying to go?

say:0:1010121601:0.text: That looks like it might be a gruglin's club!
say:0:1010121601:0.source_cn: 那里，好像有咕布林拿的木棍？

say:1:1010121602:0.text: Seems so. It's got a strange smell to it.
say:1:1010121602:0.source_cn: 唔……应该是了，一股子怪味！

say:0:1010121701:0.text: The glowfly fruit is ripe! There should be plenty of juice!
say:0:1010121701:0.source_cn: 这些萤瓤果的成熟度足够了，果汁应该可以用！

say:1:1010121702:0.text: Perfect! This will do for lubricant!
say:1:1010121702:0.source_cn: 让我看看……没错，很完美，这就是合适的润滑剂！

say:2:1010121703:0.text: What are we waiting for? Let's go repair the bridge.
say:2:1010121703:0.source_cn: 那还等什么？我们赶紧回去修桥吧。

say:2:1010121801:1.text: Great! Now we can get across to Southville!
say:2:1010121801:1.source_cn: 太好啦！这下就能过桥去南村了！

say:3:1010121802:1.text: Why do you look unhappy, Rowan?
say:3:1010121802:1.source_cn: 罗万少爷，你怎么看起来不太开心的样子？

say:4:1010121803:1.text: Well, it's because of the bridge... It was all too easy to stop traffic between the two places. All you have to do is break the lever.
say:4:1010121803:1.source_cn: 唔，因为这座桥的位置……只要破坏掉机关，就能轻而易举地...

say:5:1010121804:1.text: I was able to repair it this time, but it'll be a problem for caravans in the future.
say:5:1010121804:1.source_cn: 这次是因为恰巧我能修理，所以能够恢复通行，但对于商队货...

choice_prompt:6:1010121804.text: I was able to repair it this time, but it'll be a problem for caravans in the future.
choice_prompt:6:1010121804.source_cn: 这次是因为恰巧我能修理，所以能够恢复通行，但对于商队货车来说可就麻烦了。

say:7:1010121805:1.text: Yes, a bridge that can be rendered uncrossable so easily, as well as an unsafe business environment...
say:7:1010121805:1.source_cn: 是啊。一座如此轻易就能被破坏的桥，以及混乱而危险的商贸...

say:8:1010121806:1.text: I need to re-evaluate my business venture...
say:8:1010121806:1.source_cn: 有必要重新评估构建周边商贸渠道的计划了……

say:0:1010121901:0.text: Are you going to explore new vendors next? Or would you like to come with us?
say:0:1010121901:0.source_cn: 小少爷接下来是要去考察新货源吗？要不要跟我们一起？

say:1:1010121902:0.text: Thanks for everything, but I'm used to negotiating on my own.
say:1:1010121902:0.source_cn: 感谢你们的好意！我还是更习惯自己商谈。

say:2:1010121903:0.text: I'll be going. Looking forward to working with you next time!
say:2:1010121903:0.source_cn: 我先走了，期待下次与你们的合作。

say:0:1010122101:0.source_cn: 咕布林的木棍，萤瓤果的汁液……

say:1:1010122102:0.text: We have everything. Let's hurry back to the bridge!
say:1:1010122102:0.source_cn: 检查无误，有这些材料就可以修复桥头的机关了，咱们赶快回去吧。
